import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAX_N = 5005;
    static final int MAX_M = 5050;

    static class PathEdge {
        int src, dest, cap, flow, cost;
        PathEdge(int s, int d, int cp, int fl, int cs) {
            src = s;
            dest = d;
            cap = cp;
            flow = fl;
            cost = cs;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int vertices;
        List<PathEdge> edgeList;
        List<Integer>[] adjList;
        boolean[] visited;
        int[] minDist;
        int[] prevEdgeIdx;
        int[] pathBottleneck;

        MinCostMaxFlow(int maxVertices) {
            adjList = new List[maxVertices];
            for (int i = 0; i < maxVertices; i++) {
                adjList[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            visited = new boolean[maxVertices];
            minDist = new int[maxVertices];
            prevEdgeIdx = new int[maxVertices];
            pathBottleneck = new int[maxVertices];
            edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        void reset(int v) {
            vertices = v;
            for (int i = 0; i <= v; ++i) {
                adjList[i].clear();
            }
            edgeList.clear();
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, int capacity, int weight) {
            edgeList.add(new PathEdge(u, v, capacity, 0, weight));
            edgeList.add(new PathEdge(v, u, 0, 0, -weight));
            int idx = edgeList.size();
            adjList[u].add(idx - 2);
            adjList[v].add(idx - 1);
        }

        boolean findPath(int s, int t, int[] flow, int[] totalCost) {
            Arrays.fill(minDist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            Arrays.fill(pathBottleneck, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();

            minDist[s] = 0;
            pathBottleneck[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            q.add(s);

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                visited[u] = false;

                for (int idx : adjList[u]) {
                    PathEdge e = edgeList.get(idx);
                    if (e.cap > e.flow && minDist[e.dest] > minDist[u] + e.cost) {
                        minDist[e.dest] = minDist[u] + e.cost;
                        prevEdgeIdx[e.dest] = idx;
                        pathBottleneck[e.dest] = Math.min(pathBottleneck[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                        if (!visited[e.dest]) {
                            visited[e.dest] = true;
                            q.add(e.dest);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (minDist[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) return false;
            flow[0] += pathBottleneck[t];
            totalCost[0] += minDist[t] * pathBottleneck[t];
            int cur = t;
            while (cur != s) {
                int edge = prevEdgeIdx[cur];
                PathEdge e = edgeList.get(edge);
                e.flow += pathBottleneck[t];
                PathEdge reverseEdge = edgeList.get(edge ^ 1);
                reverseEdge.flow -= pathBottleneck[t];
                cur = e.src;
            }
            return true;
        }

        int computeMinCost(int s, int t) {
            int[] flow = {0};
            int[] cost = {0};
            while (findPath(s, t, flow, cost));
            return cost[0];
        }
    }

    static int inputInt() {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        return scanner.nextInt();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = scanner.nextInt();
        int M = scanner.nextInt();
        int K = scanner.nextInt();
        int C = scanner.nextInt();
        int D_val = scanner.nextInt();
        
        int[] A = new int[K + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; ++i) {
            A[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }

        int sourceNode = 0;
        int targetNode = N * 100 + 1;
        
        MinCostMaxFlow graphSolver = new MinCostMaxFlow(N * 100 + 2);

        for (int i = 1; i <= K; ++i) {
            graphSolver.connect(sourceNode, 1 + (A[i] - 1) * 100, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            int base = (i - 1) * 100;
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                graphSolver.connect(base + j, base + j + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE, C);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; ++i) {
            graphSolver.connect(i, targetNode, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }

        while (M-- > 0) {
            int x = scanner.nextInt();
            int y = scanner.nextInt();
            for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i) {
                int fromNode = (x - 1) * 100 + i;
                int toNode = (y - 1) * 100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; ++j) {
                    int cost = D_val * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1)) + C;
                    graphSolver.connect(fromNode, toNode, 1, cost);
                }
            }

            for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i) {
                int fromNode = (y - 1) * 100 + i;
                int toNode = (x - 1) * 100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; ++j) {
                    int cost = D_val * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1)) + C;
                    graphSolver.connect(fromNode, toNode, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(graphSolver.computeMinCost(sourceNode, targetNode));
    }
}
